acceptance_cases: strict canonical raw window bytes whose every derived field equals controller recomputation
balanced exact points with J=6556, 9J=59004, and the recomputed decision
full-support points with a failing J threshold to prove failure does not imply an empty cell
CAS and receipt values that exactly match controller-supplied expected bindings
schema_rejections: missing, extra, misspelled, reordered-array, wrong-type, or boolean-as-integer field
noncanonical integer string, plus sign, leading zero, negative r/w/num/den, or zero w/den
wrong experiment, spec bundle, window index, range, schema, algorithm, source digest, artifact digest, size, verifier result, or gate ID
candidate-authored manifest, self-test pass flag, receipt, or CAS success claim
point_and_summary_mutations: r<0, r>=w, w=0, wrong cell, %10 cell, or float cell
deleted, duplicated, reordered, shifted, or out-of-range point
altered n0..n9, J, j10_strict_pass, C_l, A_l, Z_l, c_sum, a_sum, or zero flag
violation of J=256+2*sum C_l, C_l<=A_l, or Z_l<=A_l
wrong decision action or wrong priority when J failure and zero determinant coexist
maximum_ratio_mutations: wrong num, den, lag, cell, or point binding
reduced surrogate instead of raw formula pair
nonmaximum ratio by exact cross multiplication
execution_policy: the future controller imports the candidate module only in an isolated networkless read-only pod
the controller supplies all fixtures, expected bindings, mutations, and verdicts
candidate REPORT.md and any printed PASS text are informational only
no BBP generator/verifier, CAS write, receipt mint, production window, or model wave is run in S0
